sources.notes: Road surfaces are triangulated directly between this layout's saved road boundaries. Elevation follows the approximately 47 m terrain raster, not a survey of the road. Curbs are geometry-based illustrations on curved boundaries; their locations, widths, heights and colours are assumed, not extracted from imagery. Banking is unknown. The source is an open route or branch network, without one validated closed driving order. Choose an embedded component route for playback and recording; this network does not represent a single lap. Boundary coordinates and their separate feature-level licence are preserved. Imagery loads externally on demand; no image bytes or meshes are stored.

notes: The operator's published course plan identifies the closed main circuit with the northern and southern hairpins and western return. Exact independent source way 734690065 indices 5 through 64 retain its closed paved course, excluding the straight's southern extension. Public satellite imagery independently confirms these physical course branches. Fine corner alignment and direction remain draft. Exact source coordinates are unchanged; historical alignment and direction remain provisional.

borderInference.note: Automatically inferred from RGB differences along cross-sections of the existing trace. Evidence scores are not calibrated positional confidence. Borders are estimates and have not been manually reviewed; shadows, trees, aprons, paint and imagery age can move the detected edge. Imagery resolution is not survey accuracy.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 47 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the midpoint of corresponding border stations, not an official length measurement. There is no saved GPS start gate; the simulation begins at the first trace coordinate. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.

notes: The operator course plan identifies the inner hairpin alternative connecting the northern cross-course section to the western return. Exact independent source way 734690066 preserves both real mapped junction endpoints. This connecting branch is not a separately timed lap. Exact source coordinates are unchanged; historical alignment and direction remain provisional.
